action_description: heavy cannon shot: he swings the big red and gold cannon down from his shoulder, braces his short legs and aims forward, a big BOOM shot with a flash at the muzzle, the strong recoil knocks his whole body backward and he skids back a little with his ears flapping, then he hops back and puts the cannon on his shoulder with a happy grin; keep the same south-east diagonal facing in every frame, do not turn toward the camera
